Senior platform engineer with 15+ years building distributed systems, data pipelines, and AI/ML infrastructure. Track record of cross-team technical leadership at scale.

resumes.name: Platform Engineer - 2026 Q1
resumes.description: Emphasizes distributed systems, platform architecture, and AI/ML infrastructure. Targets staff+ IC and architect roles.

role_archetypes.name: AI Systems Engineer / AI Platform Architect
role_archetypes.description: Designs and builds production ML/AI infrastructure: model serving, training pipelines, vector stores, embedding services, and LLM orchestration layers.
role_archetypes.signals_positive: ML infrastructure, model serving, training pipeline, vector database, LLM orchestration, embedding service, MLOps, GPU cluster
role_archetypes.signals_negative: frontend only, marketing automation, junior data analyst, manual QA

role_archetypes.name: Staff Platform Architect
role_archetypes.description: Cross-team technical leadership for platform and infrastructure. Drives architectural decisions, defines system boundaries, and mentors engineering teams.
role_archetypes.signals_positive: platform architecture, system design, cross-team influence, technical strategy, API design, distributed systems, mentorship
role_archetypes.signals_negative: individual contributor only, no architecture scope, ticket taker, single-team

role_archetypes.name: Principal Data Platform Engineer
role_archetypes.description: Owns data infrastructure at scale: data pipelines, warehousing, streaming, and analytical platform services.
role_archetypes.signals_positive: data platform, data pipeline, streaming, data warehouse, Spark, Kafka, Flink, dbt, analytical infrastructure
role_archetypes.signals_negative: BI analyst, dashboard builder, Excel reporting, entry-level data

role_archetypes.name: Developer Relations / Technical Evangelist
role_archetypes.description: External-facing technical role bridging engineering and developer community. Produces technical content, speaks at conferences, and drives API/SDK adoption.
role_archetypes.signals_positive: developer relations, developer advocacy, technical writing, conference speaking, SDK adoption, API evangelism, community building
role_archetypes.signals_negative: sales quota, cold calling, non-technical marketing, pure product management

rubric_dimensions.name: Role Scope
rubric_dimensions.description: Cross-team influence and architectural reach vs. narrow single-team execution.
rubric_dimensions.signals_positive: cross-team, architectural influence, system design ownership, technical strategy
rubric_dimensions.signals_negative: ticket taker, narrow scope, single feature team, no design authority

rubric_dimensions.name: Technical Depth
rubric_dimensions.description: Infrastructure and platform work vs. web/feature dev.
rubric_dimensions.signals_positive: infrastructure, platform, distributed systems, systems programming, performance engineering
rubric_dimensions.signals_negative: WordPress, Squarespace, basic CRUD, landing pages, no-code

rubric_dimensions.name: Operational Burden
rubric_dimensions.description: On-call/SRE load vs. platform engineering focus.
rubric_dimensions.signals_positive: platform engineering, build tools, developer experience, automation
rubric_dimensions.signals_negative: 24/7 on-call, pager duty primary, incident commander rotation, SRE-heavy

rubric_dimensions.name: Industry Alignment
rubric_dimensions.description: Company mission and product category alignment with candidate interests.
rubric_dimensions.signals_positive: developer tools, AI/ML, data infrastructure, open source, cloud platform

rubric_dimensions.name: Employment Structure
rubric_dimensions.description: Direct hire vs. staffing agency/contract positions.
rubric_dimensions.signals_negative: staffing agency, contract-to-hire, vendor chain, W2 through third party, corp-to-corp

rubric_dimensions.name: Seniority Mismatch
rubric_dimensions.description: Role level vs. candidate expectations for staff+ positions.
rubric_dimensions.signals_positive: staff, principal, distinguished, fellow, architect, VP engineering, director
rubric_dimensions.signals_negative: junior, entry-level, associate, new grad, 0-2 years experience, intern

rubric_dimensions.name: Compensation Red Flags
rubric_dimensions.description: Compensation transparency and alignment with staff/principal market expectations.
rubric_dimensions.signals_positive: transparent compensation range, top-of-range meets target minimum, staff/principal market rate
rubric_dimensions.signals_negative: equity-only compensation, unpaid or volunteer, below market for principal-level, hourly contractor rate far below salary

rubric_dimensions.name: Culture & Work Model
rubric_dimensions.description: Remote-first culture, work-life balance, and engineering autonomy indicators.
rubric_dimensions.signals_positive: remote-first, async-first, work-life balance, engineering autonomy, written communication culture, high-trust low-chaos
rubric_dimensions.signals_negative: mandatory return-to-office, 4+ days on-site, 60+ hour weeks, military-style command, fast-paced high-pressure, ambiguous expectations

rubric_dimensions.name: Ethical Alignment
rubric_dimensions.description: Company mission alignment with humane and privacy-respecting values.
rubric_dimensions.signals_positive: mission-driven, humane impact, privacy-respecting, healthcare, education, public-good
rubric_dimensions.signals_negative: weapons manufacturing, military contracting, surveillance technology, behavioral profiling, predatory lending

rubric_dimensions.name: Neurodivergence Compatibility
rubric_dimensions.description: Structured processes, predictable workflows, and low-meeting culture for neurodivergent-friendly work environments.
rubric_dimensions.signals_positive: clear communication norms, structured processes, predictable workflows, low-meeting culture, async-first, psychological safety
rubric_dimensions.signals_negative: constant context switching, interrupt-driven, ambiguity without support, high-meeting culture, synchronous dependency, chaotic environment
